newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg forms tyre JV in S. Africa.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg forms tyre JV in S. Africa.

text.p: Swedish rubber and mining company Trelleborg AB said on Thursday it was setting up a joint venture in South Africa to distribute agricultural and industrial tyres.
Trelleborg said it would own 70 percent of the Johannesburg-based joint venture, which will be formed with its current distributor, Wheelbound Africa Pty Ltd.
The Stassen family would own the remaining 30 percent and the new company would acquire the assets of Wheelbound Africa.
"The company is estimated to have a turnover of about 25 million crowns in 1998 and about 20 employees," Trelleborg said.
"The agricultural market in South Africa is in an expansion phase and Trelleborg's market potential for wide tractor and equipment tyres is seen to be significant."
